results.title: India's Free Trade Agreements Could Boost GDP By $170 Billion By 2035
results.description: India's expanding free trade agreements could increase GDP by $140 billion to $170 billion by 2035, according to Bloomberg Economics. The report expects diversified export markets to cushion higher US tariffs, while new trade partnerships could boost investment and productivity. Artificial intelligence could further support economic growth over time

results.title: Cuba Revises Oil Regulations and Opens the Door to MSMEs
results.description: Decree-Law 135 and its implementing regulations establish royalties, timeframes, and new avenues for participation for foreign and domestic private investors. They come after three decades of declining production, a thwarted ambition in the Gulf, and the departure of the last foreign partners due to pressure from the United States. Officials themselves admit that a new law will not suffice to attract the capital the industry needs.
